definitions.gloss: ticket booth; ticket counter; ticket window
definitions.explanation: A location where tickets are sold, especially at train stations.

examples.japanese: {切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a ticket at the ticket counter.

examples.japanese: {切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a commuter pass at the ticket counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a long line at the station's ticket booth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えなかった→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since the ticket machine wasn't working, I decided to buy at the ticket counter window.

notes:
{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば} is the place in a station or venue where tickets are sold, whether a staffed window or the ticket area as a whole. It is the everyday word a traveler uses when asking where to buy a ticket.

STRUCTURE:
⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧ (ticket) + ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (selling place). The second element is the general-purpose word for a place where something is sold, so the same pattern gives ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ and ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧.

MODERN CONTEXT:
Many stations now have ⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧ (ticket vending machines), but a staffed {切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば} still exists for:
・⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧ (commuter passes)
・⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧ (limited express tickets)
・Complex or multi-leg routes
・Assistance with fares and refunds

SYNONYMS:
・⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧ - service window or counter; the staffed window inside a {切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}
・⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ - the usual wording for concerts, sports, and other events, where {切符|きっぷ} sounds dated

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧ - ticket vending machine
・⟦{改札口|かいさつぐち}→改札口：09552_kaisatsuguchi⟧ - ticket gate
・⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ - station

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ - to buy at the ticket counter
・{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ - to queue at the ticket counter
・{切符|きっぷ}{売|う}り{場|ば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ - Where is the ticket counter?
